info.title: Mac MCP Server
info.description: OpenAPI schema for connecting Mac MCP Server to Custom GPT Actions. Every MCP tool is exposed as one named REST operation; legacy grouped REST endpoints remain available for compatibility but are intentionally omitted from this published schema.

servers.description: Replace with your own static ngrok dev domain.

post.summary: Run a shell command on macOS using zsh
post.description: Runs a local command and returns bounded output and timing information.
Returns immediately with a job_id. Use get_job_status, get_job_output, and stop_job to manage it.

timeout_s.description: Maximum runtime in seconds; capped by the server.

no_output_timeout_s.description: Terminate if no output is produced for this many seconds.

tail_lines.description: Return only the last N lines.

since_offset.description: Return output after this byte offset.

post.summary: Wait for background jobs to finish
post.description: Returns a bounded response even when a job is still running.

timeout_s.description: Maximum wait in seconds; the response is bounded.

post.summary: Run independent shell commands in parallel
Write multiple files in one call

length.description: Maximum number of lines to return.

post.summary: Read multiple files in one call
Find and replace text in a file
Move or rename a file or directory
Create a directory and its parents

pattern.description: Glob pattern such as *.py or report*.

path.description: Root directory; defaults to the current user's home.

post.description: The server terminates timed-out AppleScript process groups.

timeout_s.description: Timeout in seconds; hard-capped by the server.

post.summary: Write text to the Mac clipboard

content.description: Text to place on the clipboard.

app_name.description: Application name, such as Safari or Finder.

post.summary: Open a URL in the default browser
Add a reminder to macOS Reminders

due_date.description: Optional date such as month/day/year HH:MM AM/PM.

post.summary: Register, verify, open, or Save As a local artifact
post.description: Uses explicit artifact_id + matching path and SHA-256 identity. register/inspect verify local identity; open_preview verifies Preview opened the same file; preview_save_as drives the native Save panel and verifies the saved artifact.

path.description: Local file path. Existing artifact operations require this to match artifact_id.

artifact_id.description: Artifact handle returned by register or browser_wait_for_download.

overwrite.description: Allow an existing destination only after native Replace confirmation is observed.

200.description: Artifact operation result returned as JSON.

post.summary: Read a compact unified Mac snapshot
post.description: Collect independent read-only Mac context in parallel. Defaults to apps, native windows, Finder context, browser tabs, clipboard metadata without clipboard contents, and basic system info. Section failures are returned as partial results.

sections.description: Optional subset of snapshot sections; all six are returned by default.

max_output_bytes.description: Approximate maximum JSON response size; oversized section data is compacted.

200.description: Compact snapshot result returned as JSON.

post.description: Returns observation_id plus process-bound app_handle and stable window_handle values when the native window can be uniquely identified.

app.description: Optional application; defaults to the frontmost app.

app_handle.description: Process-bound app handle returned by a previous mac_observe.

window_handle.description: Stable native window handle returned by a previous mac_observe.

ocr.description: Use OCR only when Accessibility text is insufficient.

post.description: Use observation_id and native app/window handles for re-resolved targeting. Post-action state defaults to compact delta mode; choose none/delta/full explicitly when needed. Background-safe AX actions preserve the current user focus by default; global-input actions temporarily focus the target and restore the prior app/window.

items.description: Action object; supported types include click, double_click, scroll, type, paste, key, shortcut, drag, accessibility_action, and menu.

app_handle.description: Process-bound app handle returned by mac_observe.

window_handle.description: Stable native window handle returned by mac_observe.

state_mode.description: Post-action state detail. 'delta' returns only changed UI state and is the default; 'none' skips post-state; 'full' returns a complete Accessibility refresh.

include_screenshot.description: Include a post-action screen image. Omitted by default in every state mode.

return_state.description: Legacy compatibility alias: false maps to state_mode='none' and true maps to state_mode='full'. Prefer state_mode.

preserve_focus.description: Preserve the user's current frontmost app/window when possible. Temporarily focused global-input actions restore the prior focus. Set false only when intentionally leaving the target foreground.

pattern.description: Text or regular expression to search for.

path.description: Root directory; defaults to the current user's home.

items.description: Extension such as py or js.

post.summary: Search file names with macOS Spotlight
Open a URL in Safari or Google Chrome
Execute JavaScript in a browser tab
Click a browser element by CSS selector
Type text into a browser element

started_after_epoch_ms.description: Optional epoch milliseconds captured immediately before the download-triggering action; allows fast downloads completed before this wait call to be identified safely.

stable_ms.description: Required unchanged size/mtime window before completion is accepted.

post.description: Returns completed=true only after a new/matching file is stable, then returns artifact_id plus SHA-256 identity for downstream Preview/open/upload operations.

post.summary: Select a verified artifact into a browser file input
post.description: Selects only the file; does not submit the surrounding form. Safari uses the native Open panel; Chrome uses the private debugger bridge. The exact registered artifact is re-verified before and after selection.

path.description: Must exactly match the path bound to artifact_id.

tab_handle.description: Stable tab handle from browser_list_tabs; preferred over tab_index.

200.description: Verified file-input selection result returned as JSON.

post.summary: Press a key in a browser

items.description: Modifier such as cmd or shift.

post.summary: Read the visible browser DOM tree
Ask the local user an interactive question
post.description: Use during autonomous tasks when a local answer or missing information is needed.

question.description: Question shown in a native macOS dialog.

post.summary: Ask the user to choose from native buttons
post.description: Cancel and timeout return a bounded result without leaving a background process.

question.description: Question shown in the native dialog.

choices.description: Two to three native button labels.

post.summary: Ask the user for explicit Yes/No confirmation
post.description: Only an explicit confirm button produces confirmed=true; deny, cancel, close, and timeout are false.

question.description: Question shown in the native dialog.
